mechanism: Both drugs can cause hyperkalemia and renal dysfunction; sirolimus may increase candesartan levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, and combined use increases risk of acute kidney injury and immunosuppression complications.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and renal function regularly; adjust candesartan dose if necessary and counsel on hyperkalemia symptoms; this combination is common in renal transplant patients but requires close surveillance.
